faq_heading: New construction in Ladner: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Ladner where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Ladner?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were condos in Neilsen Grove: median build year 2021, 9 sales, median price $840,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Ladner?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was houses in Port Guichon: 14 days to sell at a median, closing at 95.6% of the list price.

blocks.text: The search above lists active MLS® listings in Ladner where the board's age field reads 0 or less. In practice that is a home finished this year, or one listed with a year built still to come. It covers houses, townhomes and condos; land and income properties are left out. Many presale projects are sold directly by the developer and only reach the MLS® close to completion, so this search is shorter than the full presale market.

Ladner overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across Ladner, 117 houses sold at a median of $1,340,000, with the middle half between $1,150,000 and $1,550,000. They took 16 days and closed at 96.8% of the list price, and the median build year was 1986. The typical house sat on a lot of about 6,008 square feet. The median moved from $1,265,000 (November to January) to $1,180,000 (August to October).

Ladner townhomes over the past year: 62 sales, a median of $890,000, and a middle half from $838,075 to $1,051,250. The median home was built in 2010, took 38 days to sell and closed at 97.4% of list. Strata fees were a median $432 a month. The median moved from $898,000 (November to January) to $875,000 (August to October).

Across Ladner, 49 condos sold at a median of $600,000, with the middle half between $529,000 and $655,700. They took 35 days and closed at 97.0% of the list price, and the median build year was 1996. Strata fees were a median $495 a month.

Ladner duplexes over the past year: 8 sales, a median of $1,498,900, and a middle half from $1,479,175 to $1,552,925. The median home was built in 2026, took 26 days to sell and closed at 100.0% of list.
